item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00488","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C07","C08","C06"],"selected_candidate_label":"C07","confidence":0.92,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C07 provides a concrete transfer template closely mirrored in the child: transfer of functions to a new administering agency followed by transfer of related personnel, records, and property in amounts determined jointly by the heads of the originating and receiving entities. C08 is a highly relevant direct institutional predecessor and contains similar machinery for moving civil-defense activities, primarily engaged employees, and records from the National Security Resources Board to the Federal Civil Defense Administration, but its phrasing is less closely matched to the child's joint-determination clause. C06 also parallels the sequence of transferring functions and associated records/property, though less precisely.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"There shall be transferred to the Federal Civil Defense Administration such of the property and records ... as relate ... to the functions transferred ... and such of the personnel ... as the said Chairman and Administrator shall jointly determine","parent_excerpt":"There shall be transferred to the Economic Cooperation Administration so much of the personnel, records, and property ... which relate to said functions ... as the Secretary of State and the Administrator for Economic Cooperation shall jointly determine","explanation":"Distinctive shared formulation transfers personnel, records, and property associated with transferred functions, with scope fixed jointly by the heads of the transferring and receiving organizations."},{"child_excerpt":"So much of the health services and special weapons defense functions ... is hereby transferred to the Federal Civil Defense Administration","parent_excerpt":"The Administrator for Economic Cooperation shall perform the functions heretofore performed by the Secretary of State","explanation":"Both begin by reallocating specified functions to a new administrator and then provide for transfer of the supporting organizational assets."}]}
